summary: Today brings a retail and market-driven update highlighted by major FMCG price shifts and corporate expansion talks. Key drivers include HUL's price increases across core brands, Nielsen's e-commerce market data, and Reliance Jio's US partnership negotiations.

bullets.text: Hindustan Unilever hiked prices of detergent brands Surf Excel, Rin, and Wheel by up to 11% due to elevated commodity inflation.
Nielsen reports that e-commerce's share of India's FMCG retail sales has tripled over the past two years.
ITAT granted tax relief to Senior Advocate Maninder Singh regarding residential properties used as professional law offices.
Reliance Jio is negotiating potential tech-for-equity partnerships with US cable companies Comcast and Charter.
France accused Iranian military hackers of overriding refrigeration controllers at 700 retail sites, spoiling millions in inventory.
